mechanism_narrative: A positive revision to quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicates stronger economic activity, increasing corporate earnings expectations and driving S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 is revised upward.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment increase exceeding 500,000 persons signals robust labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative when PAYEMS growth exceeds 500k.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% indicates weak economic activity, reducing corporate profit margins and investor confidence, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and stable inflation (CPIAUCSL < 230) signal a favorable monetary environment, reducing discount rates and increasing equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative when both FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL < 230.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle, rising industrial production (INDPRO > 97.5) indicates strengthening supply chains and manufacturing activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of instances during monetary easing cycles with INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in CPIAUCSL exceeding 0.5% indicates cooling inflation, reducing the likelihood of aggressive monetary tightening and supporting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL declines > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST > 750) and real sales (RSAFS growth > 1%) signal robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative when both HOUST > 750 and RSAFS growth > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.0%), low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signal accommodative monetary policy, stimulating economic recovery and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
regime_hint: high unemployment with low interest rates
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 8.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.
